taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: Admission webhook selection, authentication and failure behavior
controls.source_trace: Determine which operations/resources reach the webhook and whether equivalent API paths or webhook failures admit an object violating the intended invariant.
controls.implementation_branch: Resolve webhook rules, namespace/object selectors, match conditions, failurePolicy and reinvocation behavior for the actual API operation. A fail-open timeout is material only when a required admission restriction is thereby skipped. Operator-supplied webhook configuration is privileged setup; do not label that setup itself an unprivileged bypass or cause production timeouts.
controls.controlled_verification: Use an isolated cluster fixture with inert pods/config and compare compliant object, policy violation and controlled webhook unavailability.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A fail-open setting is not a demonstrated dangerous admission without an in-scope violated workload policy; an excluded object may be intentional.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Align matching and failure behavior with the enforced invariant and retest availability recovery and legitimate admissions.
